name: Chaldea
overview: Scripture identifies Chaldea as the homeland of Abraham, specifically Ur of the Chaldees, from which God called him to inherit the promised land (Genesis 11:28, 11:31, 15:7). The land of the Chaldeans was established by the Assyrians, who founded the cities and towers in a wilderness region (Isaiah 23:13). The character of the Chaldean people is described as bitter and hasty, known for their swift and forceful conquests (Habakkuk 1:6). These verses collectively reveal God's sovereign plan in calling Abraham from a people marked by a harsh and aggressive nature, emphasizing His power to redeem and direct history according to His purposes.
